description: Connect your own Plex server account and sync watched and in-progress state, playback positions and play counts into Movies, TV and Anime, with a Watch in Plex link.
name: Plex Media Sync

permissions.rationale: Create or enrich your own Movies, TV and Anime records from your Plex libraries, with watch state, progress, play counts and a 'Watch in Plex' link. Local edits and ambiguous matches go to review.
Read your Plex server (and plex.tv once at sign-in, to identify the account) with the token you provide. Reads only; redirects are refused.
Keep your Plex credential, connection, library choices, sync checkpoint and review queue in this plugin's private storage.
Run your opt-in personal Plex autosync and Connections → Sync now on the server, one bounded step at a time.
List Plex on Settings → Account → Connections with its connection status and Sync now.

scheduled_tasks.description: Sync your connected Plex libraries. Each run advances one bounded checkpoint and continues until the census is complete; local notes, ratings and edits are preserved.
scheduled_tasks.name: Plex autosync
